heading: Naomi Osaka’s family faced eviction: How did she rise to Grand Slam glory?
author: Times of India Editorial
paragraphs: During the evolution of her remarkable tennis career, which boasts four Grand Slam titles and a peak world ranking of number one, Naomi Osaka navigated challenging eviction notices. Beyond her athletic achievements, she has ventured into investments and sports ownership, notably launching successful skincare and media companies. Currently, she is ambitiously embracing luxury fashion projects, showcasing her versatility beyond the tennis court.
